assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq, TruSeq stranded mRNA), HISAT2 alignment, FPKM (S5.4.p1, GEO data_processing)
samples: male C57BL/6 mice, young (9 wk) and old (84 wk), control or 4 weeks treadmill exercise; n=3 mice per group; soleus (SOL) and gastrocnemius (GAS) from each mouse; 24 libraries (S5.1.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 4 weeks of treadmill exercise on gene expression within each muscle (SOL, GAS) and age group: YE vs YC and OE vs OC, separately in SOL and GAS
planned_contrasts: SOL YE/YC (S2.3.p1; paper: 31 DEGs, 11 up / 20 down)
GAS YE/YC (S2.3.p1; paper: 13 DEGs, 7 up / 6 down)
SOL OE/OC (S2.4.p1; paper: 20 DEGs, 10 up / 10 down)
GAS OE/OC (S2.4.p1; paper: 13 DEGs, 6 up / 7 down)
non_exercise_contrasts_in_paper: OC/YC per tissue (aging, S2.2.p1: 196 SOL, 119 GAS) and SOL vs GAS per group (S2.5.p1, p<0.05 & FC>2); not part of the exercise estimand
normalization: FPKM -> +1, log2, quantile normalization with preprocessCore (S5.5.p1)
paper_method: independent t-test per gene on the pre-processed data, Bioconductor genefilter (S5.6.2.p1); each comparison uses only its two groups
repeated_measure_unit: mouse (SOL and GAS from the same animal; sample suffixes match across tissues); not relevant within a tissue
paper_results: Tables 2-3 named genes: Nr1d1 down in SOL and GAS YE/YC; Pik3r1 up SOL / down GAS YE/YC; Pnpla3 up in both OE/OC; Hbb-b1 up SOL / down GAS OE/OC; Chtop down SOL / up GAS OE/OC. GSEA Hallmark (Tables 9, 11-13).
